title: Leaving Agabama to run his father's beach restaurant
summary: After Agabama (1933-36) he quit to work with his father's restaurant at a beach.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work

blocks.x: Okay. Ahhh - Okay. You were with Agabama for three years. After Agabama, where did you go?
I quit the sextet and I went with my father. My father opened a restaurant in a beach, like let's say Jones Beach.
